items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with Charles at the school, I think.

ctx.x: Did you interface with any of the other musicians there in Los Angeles?

I did one job, as I can remember, because at that time, Charles Lloyd was at USC. I played with Charles at the school, I think. Billy Higgins was playing drums. I don’t remember who the bass player was. But that was the only time I remember actually playing, because I couldn’t do it legally, because they didn’t let you do it. If you’re in the military, you can’t work any jobs. So if it’s one of them under-the-radar kind of jobs, fine. See? But that was it.
Do you know how Ornette and Blackwell first got together? Do you know anything about their early . . . ?

items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That would be different guys, and if you get to that town, check out Ellis Marsalis.

ctx.x: That would be different guys, and if you get to that town, check out Ellis Marsalis. If you get out over here, check out this guy.
